title: Stage 16.2 three-domain public deterministic regression
scope: Deterministic lexical retrieval and routing/versioning invariants over the frozen three-domain-core@1.0.0 public corpus. This is regression evidence only and is not a professional legal-accuracy benchmark.

gates.rationale: Preserve the Stage 15 scoped lexical Recall@5 floor on the promoted nine-case dataset.
Preserve the Stage 15 scoped lexical MRR floor.
Domain routing must not reduce Recall@5 relative to broad retrieval on the named dataset.
Domain routing must not reduce MRR relative to broad retrieval on the named dataset.
Every scoped retrieval candidate must remain inside the deterministic Authority allowlist.
Routing must not exclude the benchmark's expected Authority before retrieval.
Evaluate the validated three-domain-core@1.0.0 1274-Article baseline rather than a partial store.
An unmapped Issue must preserve the all-READY-Pack recall fallback.
Cross-domain IP + enterprise routing must preserve the deterministic Pack union without labor leakage.
Exact citation must resolve the 2019 trademark Version through 2026-12-31 and the 2027 Version from 2027-01-01.
